name: Metamagic Rod, Enlarge
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser enlarge metamagic rod 3,000 gp
Enlarge metamagic rod 11,000 gp
Greater enlarge metamagic rod 24,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are enlarged as though using the Enlarge Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Enlarge Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser enlarge metamagic rod 1,500 gp
Enlarge metamagic rod 5,500 gp
Greater enlarge metamagic rod 12,250 gp
